messages.text: so i rang the surgery and told them youre not coming back after the maternity
you did WHAT
someone had to make the decision, you go round in circles about it
that was mine to make
and youd still be deciding at christmas. its done now
whats the 46 quid at boots
prescription and some bits
what bits. photograph the receipt
im at work
then photograph it at lunch. im not asking a lot
ive moved the joint account into my name only, easier for the mortgage people
how do i buy food then
tell me what you need and ill transfer it that morning
thats not the same and you know it
is niamh going to this thing on saturday
probably why
then im not going. and honestly neither should you
shes been my friend since school
and every time you see her you come back different. work out whats more important
you were on the phone to your mam an hour and ten
were you timing it
i notice things. she fills your head and then you pick fights with me
we talked about the garden
course you did
if you go to your sisters youre going on your own
theyre coming with me, theyve got their bags packed
try it. ill ring the school monday and tell them youve taken them without agreement
you wouldnt
try me
your phone did the thing again where it asks for the code
why are you on my phone
i was going to put the shopping list in it. whats the new code
i changed it because you read my messages to jo
so theres something in there then
find my says youre still on the ring road
traffic
for 25 minutes in one spot
i stopped for petrol
you didnt mention petrol. dont turn it off again, thats all im saying
walk me through yesterday from when you left the office
seriously?
seriously. from half five
i am not doing this again
then i draw my own conclusions and you wont like them
you werent at your mums
i was there til 9
no. the tile in the boot says otherwise and it doesnt lie
theres a what in my car
dont make it a bigger thing than it is
got the ring doorbell working and one in the kitchen now
in the kitchen? facing what
the back door. it does audio as well which is handy
i dont want to be recorded in my own house
only matters if youre doing something
ive got last nights row on my phone start to finish
you recorded me
and if you keep telling people im the problem ill let them hear what you actually sound like
how do you think your dad would take the thing from before we moved
please dont do this
im not doing anything. im pointing out that i could
so whats the actual ask here
i want you to stop talking about leaving
i still have that folder from the first year you know
you said youd deleted those
i will. when youve stopped seeing the solicitor
dont bother coming back tonight the barrel went on this afternoon
my things are in there. my work stuff
theyre in two bags by the shed
its half eleven
you should have thought about that
sit back down
im on at 6, i need to sleep
we finish this first. youre not going up until we finish it
is that what youre wearing to gemmas
whats wrong with it
nothing if you want everyone looking. change the top at least
its a jumper
youre being deliberately thick now
i dont want to control you love, i want to know youre safe, thats all it has ever been
then why do i have to justify every hour
because i worry. most people would be glad someone cared this much
i never said that about your job
you said it in the car on sunday
you do this. you build a whole version of me that doesnt exist
i know what i heard
ask anyone if that sounds like me. go on, ask them
are we going to talk about this or are we doing four days again
please
you know exactly what you did. when youre ready to say it properly ill talk
go on then. see how far you get with no car no money and no one who'll have you
my sister would have me
for a fortnight. then what
whos daniel
he works in procurement, why
he's liked four of your things this week. screenshot the whole chat
there is no chat
then screenshotting it costs you nothing does it
did you enjoy tonight
yeah it was nice
you talked to steve for a long time
he was asking about the loft
im not saying anything. im just saying i noticed, and other people noticed
ive got your tablets in my bag, youre all over the place when you take them yourself
i need them at 8
and ill be home by 9. its not the end of the world
you up
just got in
got in from where
i told you, laurens birthday
you told me drinks. it's 2am
im going to bed
dont you dare go to sleep on me. answer the phone. ANSWER IT
